findings.statement: A clean build before a lock regeneration is the only trustworthy verdict: the shared target answered with another session's metadata and the first lock was hashed from a stale binary.
The promotion journal must be validated after every append: trimming by line count silently dropped the publish row, and --check caught it.
A delegation document's owner project is part of its contract: a PLATFORM-owned standing delegation was refused by a P0-only guard until the guard accepted both.
A measurement change resets a benefit profile to draft; activation is a second recorded write with its own version.
A defect with no instrument cannot open a kata: the schema-drift half is re-anchored to T5 with a contract-test instrument class rather than fabricating a measurement.
